component.name: Penguin Player
component.summary: Your music library, offline and in full quality

description.p: Penguin Player plays the music files you already have. Point it at a folder to browse, search and play your library, with nothing going online.

ul.li: FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, MP3, AAC, Opus and Ogg Vorbis, played gapless and in full quality
Songs, albums, artists and formats, with search as you type
A queue and playlists you can reorder by dragging
Timed lyrics from your files, and a visualiser in your theme's colour
Fourteen themes, or your own, and appearance options for any of them
Sandboxed Lua plugins, such as online lyrics and your music on Discord
Media keys and the desktop's media controls

description.p: A more flexible Now Playing page, and smoother drawing on Windows.

ul.li: Now Playing's sidebar can show icons only, hide or open in full, with the arrow at its top left
Lyrics no longer change size as they scroll, and the current line stays centred
Lyrics are left out when the window is too narrow to show them beside the cover
The queue stays shown or hidden as you left it when the window is resized
A wider seek bar on Now Playing, whose controls now follow the cover smoothly as the window is resized
On Windows, the app draws with Vulkan, which runs smoother with some graphics drivers

description.p: Windows support, a waveform seek bar and a more polished look throughout.

ul.li: Now also on Windows, with an installer
Open With: play songs from your file manager, whether or not they're in your library
Waveform Seek Bar: use a song's waveform as the seek bar, switched on in Appearance
Playlists show their songs' covers, or an image of your own
Bigger cards, counts on the filter chips and a more consistent look
Online Lyrics also searches by title and album, so the album is now sent to LRCLIB too
The volume slider changes more evenly across its range
Your library is upgraded when you first start this version, and 1.0.0 can't open it after that
